errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Kategorien der Technologien dar, während die vertikale Achse die Anteile in Prozent zeigt, die von 0 bis 70 in Intervallen von 10 skaliert ist.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The horizontal axis shows the percentages ('Anteile in %') from 0 to 70, and the vertical axis lists the technology categories.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in drei Gruppen unterteilt, die jeweils einen der drei Sektoren repräsentieren
errors.evidence: The chart is structured into five groups of bars, one for each technology category. Each group contains three bars representing the three sectors, not the other way around.
This range is too narrow and incorrect. While the dark blue bar is around 62%, the light blue bar is significantly higher at approx. 67%, and the grey bar is at approx. 65%.
The stated range for 'Künstliche Intelligenz' (Artificial Intelligence) is incorrect. The grey bar for the public sector is clearly lower, at approximately 3%.
The range for 'Managementinformationssysteme' is overestimated. The highest value is 15% (dark blue bar), while the other two bars are lower (approx. 13% and 12%). 18% is not reached by any bar.
The range for 'Audiovisuelle Technologien' is overestimated. All three bars are below 10%, with values between approximately 7% and 9%.
The range for 'Internet der Dinge' is inaccurate. While one bar is at approx. 9%, the other two are significantly lower at around 5%.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The technology categories on the y-axis are sorted in descending order based on the magnitude of their values, with 'Plattformdienste' (highest values) at the top and 'Künstliche Intelligenz' (lowest values) at the bottom.

errors.text_span: aber die Kategorien sind konsistent über die drei Sektoren hinweg angeordnet.
errors.evidence: This phrase is tautological and confusing for a grouped bar chart where the categories are inherently consistent across the groups.
